Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4028801. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4028801'. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Return rows ordered by molecule_chembl_id.
